'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Brodsky DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' bbrodsky50
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
